title: Spinach Feta Scramble with Tomato Basil Salad

steps.text: Wash and dry tomatoes; slice into wedges and place in a medium bowl with oil, salt, and pepper.
Wash and dry the basil; pick the leaves off the stems and slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes and toss gently to combine the salad; set aside.
Crack the eggs into a medium bowl and season with pepper; whisk together.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Add spinach and feta to eggs and stir gently to combine.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.

Pour the egg mixture into the skillet. Scramble the eggs using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny.
To serve, divide eggs and tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!
